description: Two date jobs. difference: days between two dates (optionally counting the end day), as years/months/days, weeks, whole months, working days and weekend days for a chosen weekend (Fri–Sat default, Sat–Sun, Fri only, Sun only; public holidays are not counted). add: add or subtract days, business days, weeks, months or years to a date (month ends clamp: Jan 31 + 1 month = Feb 28/29). Results include the weekday and Umm al-Qura Hijri date. Dates are ISO YYYY-MM-DD; for Hijri ⇄ Gregorian conversion use calc_hijri. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/date-diff/

amount.description: add: how many units to add (use subtract to go back).

date.description: add: the starting date YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

inclusive.description: difference: count the end date too.

mode.description: difference between two dates, or add/subtract an amount.

subtract.description: add: go back in time instead.

weekend.description: Weekend days skipped by working-day counts.

name: calc_date_diff
title: Date difference / add days
